description: Door-to-door minutes from one neighbourhood to the user's places on a weekday morning, by public transport (R5 on TfL timetables), bike (at the speed Santander Cycles riders reach; checked against TfL), car (typical morning traffic, no parking) and walking, each with a range. Places within 1.5 km of a commute hub (King's Cross, Bank, Canary Wharf, Oxford Circus…) are routed through it; others in Greater London get a straight-line estimate (estimate: true); places outside Greater London, and every place from a neighbourhood outside London (the routing is London only), get straight-line estimates in every mode, long trips at a main-line speed (estimate: true, reason 'outside-routing'). A neighbourhood served by National Rail only also gets a rail estimate (modes.rail, estimate: true). Example routes start at the neighbourhood's MSOA centre (origin); one far from the headline minutes is representative: false and lists its lines only. Journeys over 120 minutes are not timed (minutes null, capped: true). A place takes latitude/longitude or center [longitude, latitude] from search_places; quote estimate minutes as estimates. Each mode's confidence: 'timetable' (TfL), 'routed' (London streets) or 'approximate' (straight-line estimates). googleMapsUrl opens Google Maps' own route for the user to check: its time, leaving now, not ours.

label.description: [input value] What the point is, e.g. 'Crystal Palace NSC'.
label.title: Label

any_of.description: [input value] Near either of 2-3 pinned points ('either pool', 'either office'): each area counts the quickest one.
any_of.title: Any Of

brand.description: [search: prefix] With a category: brands starting with this, any case, e.g. 'M&S', 'Waitrose' (supermarket), 'PureGym' (gym); 'A or B' for either.
brand.title: Brand

category.description: [filter: exact] Instead of a point: the nearest place of this kind (pool = public pool; step_free_station = a station TfL lists with lift access, or any DLR station or tram stop).
category.title: Category

center.description: [input value] Instead of latitude/longitude: [longitude, latitude], the `center` search_places returns.
center.title: Center

importance.description: [rank weight] 1 nice to have … 5 essential. A daily trip (work, the school run) goes right after their top priority, never last: lower in the order its weight is small.
importance.title: Importance

label.description: [input value] What the place is, e.g. 'Office', 'PureGym Angel', 'Any park' (name reads as label, lat/lng as latitude/longitude).
label.title: Label

latitude.description: [input value] A pinned place: its latitude (from search_places). For an address, `center` is its area's centre unless `centerPrecision` is `uprn`; never pin an LSOA centroid as the home.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: [input value] A pinned place: its longitude.
longitude.title: Longitude

max_minutes.description: [rank weight] The longest trip they accept.
max_minutes.title: Max Minutes

mode.description: [option] How they get there (default transit for a pin, walk for a kind). car = typical weekday-morning traffic, no parking or charges: say so.
mode.title: Mode

must.description: [option] True when an area beyond max_minutes is out of the question.
must.title: Must

school.description: [filter: exact] Instead of top_school: the nearest school matching a filter (phase, Ofsted, type, intake, faith, one results measure ≥ a threshold), optionally within N metres; max_minutes still sets the trip.

school_gender.description: [filter: exact] With top_school: only this intake.
school_gender.title: School Gender

school_rank_by.description: [option] With top_school: rank by published results (default) or by Progress 8 (secondary only: progress pupils make from their primary results, latest published year 2023/24).
school_rank_by.title: School Rank By

school_selective.description: [filter: exact] With top_school: false leaves grammars out, true keeps only them; N counts those.
school_selective.title: School Selective

sport.description: [search: contains] With sports_club: the sport, e.g. 'tennis', 'football'.
sport.title: Sport

top_school.description: [input value] Instead of a point or category: near one of the region's top N state schools (by published results), e.g. 10. Top lists hold grammars and single-sex schools; a family starts with good-primaries. Living nearby never guarantees a place: say so.
top_school.title: Top School

a_level_only.description: [filter: exact] Only sixth forms with a combined A-level rank.
a_level_only.title: A Level Only

faith.description: [filter: exact] Faith school or not (absent = any).
faith.title: Faith

measure.description: [filter: range] One results measure and its threshold.

ofsted.description: [filter: exact] Ofsted standing kept, state schools only (absent = any).
ofsted.title: Ofsted

id.description: [id] englandTopPercent = England top % (lower is better: at most the threshold); progress8, attainment8, grade5EngMaths (%), ks2RwmExpected (%) = at least the threshold; fsm6Share = free school meals % (at most). Latest published year per school; cohorts under 30 and suppressed cells have no value and never pass.
id.title: Id

threshold.description: [filter: range] The threshold in the measure's own unit, e.g. 75 for KS2 RWM 75%.
threshold.title: Threshold

filter.description: [filter: exact] Which schools count (the same filter as the map's Schools filter).

within.description: [filter: range] Metres: only a matching school this close counts (straight line); beyond it the area has none.
within.title: Within

places.description: [input value] Pinned places to reach: latitude/longitude, or center [longitude, latitude] from search_places.
places.title: Places
